gaps.sentence: The novel had a huge effect on ___ young people of the 1960s.
gaps.explanation: 'The young people of the 1960s' — defined by the of-phrase, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: ___ unemployment has fallen sharply this year.
gaps.explanation: Unemployment as a general concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ rich variety of birds lives in the Danube delta.
gaps.explanation: A rich variety of… — variety is countable here, first mention.

gaps.sentence: He is ___ most experienced teacher in the school.
gaps.explanation: Superlative + of/in-phrase: the most experienced teacher in the school.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ only person to solve the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: 'The only person' — 'only' makes the noun unique, so 'the'.
Single mountain peaks take no article: Everest, Mont Blanc (compare: the Alps).

gaps.sentence: ___ problem is that people don't recycle enough.
gaps.explanation: The problem (the one we are discussing); people in general takes no article.

gaps.sentence: She's ___ MEP for the north-west region.
gaps.explanation: 'MEP' is pronounced /em iː piː/, so the vowel sound 'an' is required.
